nextReadySlice.title: Manifest nested required-string proof
failingProof: A failing proof shows nested required string fields such as app identity, generator identity, or section contributorId are not yet covered by explicit invalid-token parser tests even though the shared helper changed.
A failing proof shows malformed nested required-string JSON can still slip past the test suite without a direct contract-level assertion.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop again for review before broader hosted/tooling inspection work if nested required-string proof reveals a contract drift or the next schema-validation step needs a design decision.
